_doc: E1 golden set — the graded reference corpus that VALIDATES the graders (does the bar actually pass known-good and fail known-bad?). `expect` is the HUMAN ground-truth label and is the whole point: it must be set by someone who watched the video and judged it against CRAFT-BAR + research/consolidated/north-star.md — never by the grader, never guessed. Paths resolve under --videos-root (default: the am-videos research/ dir). `because` records which bar clause the label turns on, so a wrong verdict is debuggable. Add entries over time; the set is a test suite.
_labels_owner: Tiago — the PASS entries are the two north-stars blessed in north-star.md. The REVISE entries below are CANDIDATES seeded from prior research notes; confirm each against the actual video before trusting the false-pass number.
